name: Container
description: Centers content in a max-width column with responsive horizontal padding and fixed size steps.

anatomy.description: A max-width wrapper that keeps content readable on wide screens.
Horizontal padding that steps up across the sm and lg breakpoints.
sm, md and lg cap the column at different widths; fluid removes the cap.

dos: Wrap page content so line lengths stay readable on wide screens.
Use size="fluid" for full-bleed bands, then nest a capped Container inside for the content.
Pass as="main" when the Container wraps the primary page content.
donts: Don't nest capped Containers; the inner cap fights the outer one.
Don't add Container inside already-narrow panels or sidebars.
Don't hand-roll your own max-width wrappers alongside it; pick one convention.

examples.title: Default page column
examples.description: Content centers at max-w-6xl with side padding that widens on larger breakpoints.

examples.title: Size variants
examples.description: sm, md and lg cap the column at different widths; fluid removes the cap for full-bleed regions.

guidance.useWhen: Page or section content should stay readable on wide screens with a consistent centered column.
guidance.avoidWhen: The content should fill the available width edge to edge; skip the wrapper or use size="fluid".
guidance.behavior: Container always spans the full available width up to its size cap and keeps a minimum padding on small screens.
guidance.responsive: Horizontal padding steps up from px-4 to px-8 across the sm and lg breakpoints while the column stays centered.

notes: Container renders a div by default; pass as="main" when it wraps the primary page content.
Centering and padding are purely visual; landmark roles come from the as prop or the content inside.

apiEntries.description: Centers content in a max-width column with responsive horizontal padding.

props.description: Maximum width of the centered column; 'fluid' removes the width cap.
props.name: size
